title: Saxophobia
identity: The catalog's Dorn edition of Saxophobia is arranged by Michael Golemo; a separate public-domain 1920 original score exists on IMSLP and must not be treated as the target edition.

evidence.claim: Groth catalog lead identifies Dorn 1193, Golemo arrangement and seven pages, but listing not independently opened.
IMSLP identifies an original 1920 Wiedoeft publication with complete score and saxophone C part.

review_focus: Compare Golemo transposition, form, and piano part with original C-part score before treating their demands as equivalent.
collection_flag: Early 20th-century saxophone novelty solo, but target arranged edition identity and exact instrument part require confirmation.

score_links.description: IMSLP identifies an original 1920 Wiedoeft publication with complete score and saxophone C part.

gaps: No target edition score or performance inspected; original C part is not Dorn/Golemo version.
Dorn 1193 instrumentation and pagination remain retailer-lead only.
